Hi Alex / Acme SecOps 

Thanks for the clear questions  answered inline below and attaching the SOC2 and penetration test summary requested. I’ve started populating the SIG spreadsheet and will upload the completed version by EOD Mon 3/16.

1) BAA: Redwood supports BAAs for customers that require HIPAA protections. For hosted customers we typically execute our standard BAA (link below) and ask for an SOW that describes the pilot scope. Legal turnaround time is ~5-10 business days after countersignature. (DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/REDWOOD-BAA-template)

2) SOC2 scope: The attached Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf covers our hosted production inference API and control environment. Staging/dev environments are not covered by that report unless explicitly contracted. If you need evidence for staging, we can discuss limited additional attestations.

3) Key management: For hosted (Redwood-managed) customers we offer encryption-at-rest with keys managed by Redwood. For Redwood Private (VPC/on-prem) we support customer-managed KMS/HSM (bring-your-own-key). We can also offer tenant-keying options for dedicated deployments on a case-by-case basis; Nikhil can follow up on specifics for Acme's desired configuration.

4) Logging & retention: We retain access logs and system-level request metadata for 90 days by default. We do not retain full request/response bodies unless customer opts into enhanced logging for debugging (in which case logs can be redacted or restricted). We can provide tailored retention policies for enterprise contracts.

Next steps: I will finish the SIG with control mappings and any evidence links by Mon 3/16. If you’d like to review the draft before we finalize, we can schedule a 30-min review next Tue.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf, PenTest_Summary_Q42025.pdf

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Trust & Security | Redwood Inference
